title: Sts. Simon and Jude, Apostles
subtitle: Feast · Eph 2:19-22; Lk 6:12-16
text: We know little of their words, but much of their faithfulness: called by name, sent out, and they went, all the way to martyrdom. The Church is built on such foundations (Eph 2:20).
